blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.
blocks.zh: 构建像人类玩家一样在开放式游戏中运行的虚拟内涵代理是一个长期的目标,既需要长视野自主,也需要可靠的本土界面控制. 作为一个在程序上产生的开放世界,Minecraft为研究这些能力的整合提供了天然的试验床. 现有代理人通常要么提供本地维乌莫托尔控制,而不具有长远的自主性,要么通过环境API或预先界定的技能执行高级规划。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议HiSTEVE,一种具有能力意识的VLA代理。 在管弦乐方面,我们配备了跟踪进展的结构化内存和一个VLM计划员,以便在VLA能力范围内选择子任务. 为了可靠地确定次级任务的完成情况,我们进一步采用了一种与政策相关的任务完成状态探测器,该探测器对志愿军的政策背景提出了条件,以表明候选人的完成情况。 在控制层面,一个单一的VLA执行所有子任务,只有视觉感知和本土键盘-和-mouse动作. 为了减少不同GUI与非GUI相互作用之间的干扰,我们引入了针对制度的 RMSNorm 分支和单独的鼠标移动符号嵌入. 我们还通过世界知识注入、仿真学习、强化学习以及环境反馈来培训VLA,以提高可靠性和恢复性。 HiSTEVE实现了最先进的原子任务性能,在MineStudio座椅上得分85.0%,在OpenHA上的平均成功率达到37.4%,同时也完成了长视距任务,如像人类玩家一样从头到尾地巧妙地制作一把铁 pick.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A long-standing goal in embodied intelligence is to build virtual embodied agents ( Fung et al., 2025 ) that can operate in open-ended games under the same interaction constraints as human players.
Achieving this goal requires two complementary capabilities: long-horizon autonomy to maintain goals and adapt plans; and reliable native-interface control to translate first-person visual observations into keyboard-and-mouse actions.
As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying these capabilities by combining partially observable, compositional tasks with diverse visuomotor interactions ( Fan et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
A generally capable Minecraft agent must therefore integrate long-horizon planning with native-interface execution in a closed loop, continually updating its decisions from visual feedback.
blocks.zh:
所体现智能的一个长期目标是构建虚拟所体现代理(Fung等,2025年),可以在与人类玩家相同的互动约束下在开放式游戏中运行.
实现这一目标需要两种互补能力:长视野自主来维持目标和调整计划;可靠的本土界面控制来将第一人称视觉观察转化为键盘-和-mouse动作.
作为一个在程序上产生的开放世界,Minecraft公司为研究这些能力提供了天然的试验床,将部分可观测的构成性任务与多种粘土活体相互作用结合起来(Fan等,2022;Zheng等,2023)。
因此,一般有能力的 " Minecraft " 代理商必须将长视距规划与本土互动执行结合起来,保持闭环,不断从视觉反馈中更新其决定。

blocks.en:
Existing Minecraft agents have primarily emphasized one of these two capabilities.
On the one hand, visuomotor policies and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models address native-interface control by directly mapping raw first-person observations to keyboard-and-mouse actions ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Lifshitz et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
However, these models typically lack mechanisms for persistently tracking task state and explicitly reasoning over task dependencies, limiting their long-horizon autonomy.
On the other hand, agents driven by large language models (LLMs) or vision-language models (VLMs) support long-horizon reasoning through task decomposition planning ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2024 ) .
However, many of these methods still rely on environment APIs, predefined skills, or functional actions for low-level execution, which may be unavailable in most games.
Although recent work has begun to combine high-level planning with learned policies ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Park et al., 2025 ) , integrating task-state tracking, completion verification, and failure recovery remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh:
现有的地雷制剂主要强调这两种能力之一。
一方面,VUOOMOTR政策和VSIV-Language-Action(VLA)模型通过直接将原始第一人称观测图映射到键盘-和-mouse行动中,解决了本土-界面控制问题(Baker等,2022;Lifshitz等,2023;Li等,2025)。
然而,这些模型通常缺乏持续跟踪任务状态的机制,也缺乏对任务依赖性进行明确推理的机制,限制了它们的长期自主性.
另一方面,由大型语言模型(LLM)或视觉语言模型(VLM)所驱动的代理通过任务分解规划支持长视距推理(Wang等,2023a; Zhu等,2023;Wang等,2024b;Li等,2024.).
然而,这些方法中很多仍然依赖于环境API,预定义技能,或功能动作来进行低等执行,这在大多数游戏中可能无法使用.
虽然最近的工作已经开始将高级别规划与学习到的政策结合起来(Wang等,2025b;Park等,2025),但整合任务状态跟踪、完成核查和故障恢复仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en:
Satisfying both requirements introduces coupled challenges at the planning and action timescales.
At the planning timescale, long-horizon autonomy requires tracking the objective, progress, and execution history across subtasks, while ensuring that plans are consistent with Minecraft mechanics and remain within the lower-level policy’s capabilities ( Wang et al., 2023b ) .
The agent must also determine when to terminate the current subtask: terminating too early leaves the subtask unfinished, whereas terminating too late wastes actions and may even undo existing progress.
At the action timescale, native-interface control requires a single VLA policy to operate reliably across heterogeneous task distributions.
In particular, non-GUI control and GUI interaction differ in both visual distributions and mouse-action semantics: mouse movement rotates the camera in the former but displaces the cursor in the latter, making naive joint training susceptible to negative transfer ( He et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Each VLA invocation must also be reliable, since even small per-subtask failure risks accumulate over repeated invocations in long-horizon tasks.
blocks.zh:
满足这两项要求在规划和行动时间尺度方面都带来了多重挑战。
在规划时间尺度上,长距离自治要求跟踪各分任务的目标、进展和执行历史,同时确保计划符合Minecraft机械,并保持在较低一级政策的能力范围内(Wang等人,2023b) 。 。 。 。
代理人还必须确定何时结束当前子任务:过早结束使子任务未完成,而结束过晚的废物行动甚至可能使现有进展被抵消。
在行动时间尺度上,本土-界面控制需要单一的VLA政策,以便在各种任务分配之间可靠地运作。
特别是,非GUI控制和GUI交互在视觉分布和鼠标动作语义上都有所不同:鼠标运动在前者旋转相机,但在后者取代了光标,使得天真的联合训练容易被负转移(He等,2026;Yang等,2026).
每一援引《志愿军法》也必须可靠,因为即使是小型的每个次任务都有可能因长期任务一再援引而累积。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent that combines a capability-aware harness for long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control.
At the slower planning timescale, we design the harness with a structured memory of task progress and a VLM planner that selects the next atomic subtask.
To close the planning–execution loop, we introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion.
The harness then verifies the task state and decides whether to advance, recover, or replan.
At the faster action timescale, the VLA predicts native keyboard-and-mouse actions from the subtask instruction and first-person visual observation.
To mitigate negative transfer across heterogeneous interaction regimes, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings for non-GUI and GUI tasks.
Following world knowledge injection and imitation learning, we further finetune the VLA through reinforcement learning (RL) to improve recovery when execution deviates from demonstration trajectories.
blocks.zh:
为了应付这些挑战,我们提议由VLA的分级代理人HiSTEVE,将长距离自主的能力意识和可靠的本土互动控制结合起来。
在较慢的规划时间尺度上,我们用结构化的任务进度内存和一个选择下一个原子子任务的VLM规划器来设计取带.
为了结束规划-执行循环,我们引入了一个与政策相衔接的任务完成状态检测器,该检测器将VLA政策背景的条件用来表示候选人的完成。
后由绳索验证任务状态,决定是推进,恢复,还是再规划.
在更快的动作时间尺度上,VLA从子任务指令和第一人称视觉观察中预测出本土键盘-和-mouse动作.
为了减少不同互动制度之间的负转移,我们引入了针对不同制度的RMSNorm分支,并为非GUI和GUI任务单独嵌入了鼠标-移动符号.
继世界知识注入和模仿学习后,我们通过强化学习(RL)来进一步微调VLA,以在行刑偏离演示轨迹时改善恢复.

blocks.en:
We comprehensively evaluate HiSTEVE on atomic and long-horizon benchmarks.
Compared with the strongest baseline in our main comparison, HiSTEVE improves average success by 20.0 20.0 percentage points on MineStudio Bench and 0.6 0.6 points on OpenHA, with family-level gains of up to 28.6 28.6 points on LongBench.
The largest long-horizon improvements occur in tasks requiring multi-stage resource production or the reuse of information gathered during exploration.
Ablations reveal that stronger atomic execution alone does not yield comparable gains in long-horizon performance.
With the VLA held fixed, the full harness more than doubles goal success relative to fixed-horizon handoff, highlighting the importance of organizing local execution around a persistent task state.
The learned completion detector also outperforms prompted general-purpose VLMs, providing more accurate completion judgments to support this execution loop.
blocks.zh:
我们对原子和长视距基准进行全面评估。
与我们的主要比较中最强的基线相比,HiSTEVE提高了MineStudio座椅的平均成功率20.0个百分点和OpenHA的平均成功率0.6个百分点,而Long Bench上的家庭一级收益高达28.6 28.6分.
最大的长距离改进发生在需要多阶段资源生产或重复利用勘探期间所收集的信息的任务上。
偏差表明,单靠更强有力的原子执行并不能在长视野的性能方面产生类似的收益.
随着VLA的被固定下来,与固定范围交接相比,全能控制比双倍多的入球成功,突出了围绕持续的任务状态组织地方执行的重要性.
所学的完成检测器也超过了通用的VLM,提供了更准确的完成判断来支持这一执行循环.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We present HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness, enabling HiSTEVE to maintain goals and adapt plans throughout long-horizon execution. • We enable reliable native-interface control through regime-specific RMSNorm branches, separate mouse-movement token embeddings, and a three-stage training strategy. • HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance and can complete long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like a human player.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Agent Harnesses for Execution
blocks.zh: 2.1 执行代理人

blocks.en:
Foundation-model agents often use an agent harness, an external orchestration layer that supports interaction across model calls ( Sumers et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
Early language agents connect language models to external knowledge and tools and alternate between reasoning and action ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Karpas et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) .
Later systems added memory, feedback-based reflection, and search-based evaluation, allowing the harness to retain experience and refine subsequent decisions ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024c ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
In long-horizon embodied tasks, agent harnesses coordinate high-level planning and low-level execution across multiple steps ( Huang et al., 2022a ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Shah et al., 2025 ) .
Such harnesses use environmental observations, feasibility assessments, and execution outcomes to continually update subsequent decisions, thereby closing the planning–execution loop ( Huang et al., 2022b ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Zhi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
Foundation-model代理经常使用一种代理吊带,一种支持跨模型调用相互作用的外部管弦系统(Sumers等,2023;Wang等,2025a;Lin等,2026.).
早期语言代理将语言模型与外部知识和工具相接,并在推理与行动之间取而代之(Nakano等,2021;Karpas等,2022;姚等,2022.).
后来的系统增加了内存,以反馈为基础的回想,并基于搜索的评价,使机能保留了经验并完善了之后的决定(周等,2023;包克等,2023;申等,2023;王等,2024c;许等,2026).
在长期任务中,代理人通过多个步骤协调高级别规划和低级别执行(Huang等人,2022a; Wang等,2024a;Shah等,2025.).
这种利用利用利用环境观测、可行性评估和执行结果不断更新后续决定,从而结束规划-执行循环(Huang等,2022b;Guo等,2024;Zhi等,2025)。

blocks.en: 2.2 VLA Models and Systems
blocks.zh: 2.2 志愿军 模型和系统

blocks.en:
VLA models map visual observations and language instructions to embodied actions ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Brohan et al., 2023 ) .
Early language-conditioned policies learned this mapping directly from multi-task demonstrations ( Shridhar et al., 2022 ; Jang et al., 2022 ; Brohan et al., 2022 ) .
As model capacity and robot datasets grew, these policies generalized to a broader range of tasks, environments, and robot embodiments ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; O’Neill et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2026 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ) .
To support long-horizon planning, hierarchical systems use a semantic planner to generate policy-compatible subtasks for execution by a low-level policy ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Ahn et al., 2022 ; Driess et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) .
More recent approaches allow intermediate reasoning or predictive representations to directly guide low-level control ( Belkhale et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
VLA模型映射视觉观测和语言指示以体现动作(Ma等,2026;Brohan等,2023.).
早期基于语言条件的政策直接从多任务演示中汲取了这种图谱 (Shridhar等,2022;Jang等,2022;Brohan等,2022.).
随着模型能力和机器人数据集的增长,这些政策被推广到范围更广的任务、环境和机器人化(Brohan等,2023;O-Neill等,2024;Team等,2024;Kim等,2024;Black等,2026;Pertsch等,2025;).
为了支持长远规划,分级系统使用语义规划器生成政策相容的子任务,由低级政策执行(Ma等,2026;Ahn等,2022;Dries等,2023;Shi等,2025.).
更近期的方法允许中间推理或预测表达直接引导低水平控制(Belkhale等,2024;Yang等,2025;Lin等,2025;Zhang等,2026b.).

blocks.en: 2.3 Game-Playing Agents in Virtual Worlds
blocks.zh: 2.3 虚拟世界游戏播放代理商

blocks.en:
Games have long served as testbeds for sequential decision making, with research progressing from search-based systems to deep RL agents ( Campbell et al., 2002 ; Mnih et al., 2015 ; Silver et al., 2016 ) .
More recently, pretrained models have been used to build agents that follow instructions and reason over observations ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) .
Researchers have also trained unified policies on multi-game data, but such policies often sacrifice control precision and long-horizon reliability ( Raad et al., 2024 ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
Alongside efforts toward cross-game generalization, Minecraft has emerged as a focused testbed for studying embodied interaction within an open world ( Guss et al., 2019 ; Fan et al., 2022 ) .
Research in Minecraft includes visuomotor policies learned directly from interaction trajectories ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Lifshitz et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , as well as LLM- or VLM-based agents for autonomous exploration and skill acquisition ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh:
游戏长期作为相继决策的试验床,研究从基于搜索的系统向深RL剂发展(Campbell等,2002;Mnih等,2015;Silver等,2016.).
最近,已使用经过预先训练的模型来制造物剂,在观察时遵循指示和理由(Ma等,2024;周等,2026;Tan等,2025)。
研究人员还培训了多游戏数据方面的统一政策,但此类政策往往牺牲控制精度和长视距可靠性(Raad等,2024;Magne等,2026;Zhang等,2026a).
Minecraft是研究开放世界内体现的相互作用的有重点试验台(Guss等人,2019年;Fan等人,2022年)。
Minecraft的研究包括直接从相互作用轨迹中吸取的粘接电动政策(Baker等,2022;Lifshitz等,2023;Li等,2025;以及LLM-或VLM-用于自主勘探和获取技能的物剂(Zhu等,2023;Wang等,2023a; Wang et al., 2024b. (原始内容存档于2019-09-22).

blocks.en: 3 Capability-Aware Harness for Long-Horizon Autonomy
blocks.zh: 3 长视距自动化的能力-智能机能

blocks.en:
We propose a capability-aware agent harness that coordinates a VLM planner and a VLA policy for long-horizon autonomy.
Specifically, we integrate capability-constrained planning, evidence-driven handoff and recovery, and structured memory (Appendix 8 ).
blocks.zh:
我们提议一种能感应力的特工手段,协调一个甚高频规划员和一个关于长距离自治的甚高频分析政策。
具体而言,我们综合了能力受限的规划、证据驱动的交接和恢复以及结构化的内存(附录8)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Capability-Constrained Planning
blocks.zh: 3.1 能力限制规划

blocks.en:
Long-horizon Minecraft tasks cannot be reliably solved through a single static plan because the environment is partially observable, and local execution failures may change the feasibility of subsequent subtasks.
Planning within the harness is reference-free: no predefined subtask sequence or expert task route is provided, and the planner selects the next atomic subtask online from the final objective and current execution context.
We constrain the planner to select and instantiate a parameterized atomic subtask schema from a set restricted to the VLA’s execution capabilities.
Each schema specifies its applicability, semantic parameters, visually observable progress and completion conditions, recognizable failure conditions, and execution budget.
blocks.zh:
长视线 Minecraft任务无法通过单一的静态计划可靠地解决,因为环境是部分可观察到的,局部执行失败可能会改变后续子任务的可行性.
牵引力内部的规划是无参考的:没有提供预先定义的子任务序列或专家任务路径,计划员从最终目标和当前执行上下文在线选择下一个原子子任务.
我们限制计划人员从一个仅限于VLA执行能力的集合中选择和即时化的原子子任务计划。
每个方案都具体规定其适用性、语义参数、可见的进展和完成条件、可识别的失败条件和执行预算。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evidence-Driven Handoff and Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 证据处理和追回

blocks.en:
To address the handoff-timing problem between high-level planning and VLA control discussed above, we introduce an evidence-driven handoff-and-recovery protocol.
During each bounded VLA invocation, the task-completion state detector estimates a completion probability for the current instruction I j I_{j} .
When this probability exceeds a confidence threshold, the current invocation ends and returns control to the harness, and exhaustion of the execution budget triggers the same handoff.
Our mechanism differs from failure detection: the detector signals candidate completion rather than execution failure, while the harness verifies progress and completion conditions using current and recent visual observations.
Based on this reassessment, the execution outcome v j v_{j} is recorded as success \mathrm{success} , failure \mathrm{failure} , or interrupted \mathrm{interrupted} , where interrupted \mathrm{interrupted} indicates that control has been returned before either success or failure can be verified.
Following verification, the harness advances if the completion conditions are satisfied and attempts local recovery if the subtask remains incomplete but recoverable.
The harness replans from the updated state if recovery is infeasible or repeatedly fails, the current subtask becomes inapplicable, or the visual state changes substantially.

blocks.en: 3.3 Structured Memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 有结构的内存

blocks.en:
Long-horizon execution requires persistent task state, but retaining the full history increases context length and accumulates unverified intermediate information.
The harness therefore maintains a compact structured memory centered on verified state transitions.
The memory system comprises four stores with distinct roles.
Working memory corresponds to the current planning state h j h_{j} and records the active objective and atomic subtask, verified task progress, unresolved requirements, and recent failures or lack of progress.
Episodic memory records the planning states before and after each VLA invocation, together with the selected subtask, the harness-verified outcome, execution cost, and diagnostic information.
Procedural memory stores reusable dependencies among parameterized subtasks derived from verified successful executions.
World memory stores landmarks and spatial relations inferred from visual observations to support subsequent planning within the current world.
At each high-level decision step, the working memory h j h_{j} is used directly, whereas task-relevant entries are retrieved from the remaining memory categories to form the R j R_{j} .

The lower-level VLA policy maps a subtask instruction with first-person visual observations to native keyboard-and-mouse actions.

blocks.en:
We represent Minecraft’s native keyboard-and-mouse actions as discrete action tokens, allowing supervised action prediction to use the same next-token prediction objective as language modeling.
Following the VPT-style action space ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , we organize each single-step action into multiple categorical action groups.
Keyboard and click inputs are represented as discrete choices within predefined action groups, while horizontal and vertical mouse displacements are μ \mu -law transformed and quantized into the same number of bins.
blocks.zh:
我们代表Minecraft的本地键盘和mouse动作作为离散的动作符号,使受监督的动作预测能够使用与语言建模相同的接地预测目标.
沿着VPT风格的动作空间(Baker等,2022年),我们组织每个单步动作组成多个绝对动作组.
键盘和点击输入在预定义的动作组中作为离散选择来表示,而水平鼠标和垂直鼠标位移被μ\mu-law被转换并被分解成同个个个个个.

blocks.en:
However, mouse displacement controls camera rotation in non-GUI interactions but cursor movement in GUI interactions, so sharing a single action token set creates an ambiguity.
We therefore assign disjoint mouse-displacement token sets: the original mouse tokens are retained for non-GUI interactions, while a separate subset is allocated to GUI interactions.
We further insert an interaction-type token at the beginning of the sequence to indicate whether the current interaction is non-GUI or GUI.
Because both sets of mouse-displacement tokens decode back to the same physical action codebook, the branching occurs solely at the representation level. We refer to this regime-separated mouse-movement token representation as Dual-Mouse . (Appendix 9.3 )

因此,我们指定了脱节的鼠标-移位令牌集:鼠标原始令牌被保留用于非GUI交互,而一个单独的子集被分配到GUI交互.

blocks.en: 4.2 Three-Stage Policy Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 三阶段政策培训

blocks.en: Because per-subtask failures compound over repeated VLA invocations, reliable long-horizon execution requires high reliability. We therefore train the VLA in three stages: world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback.
blocks.zh: 由于每个潜行失败比反复被VLA引用更为复杂,可靠的长视距执行需要高度的可靠性. 因此,我们分三个阶段对志愿军进行培训:世界知识注入、模仿学习和用环境反馈加强学习。

blocks.en:
Before reinforcement learning, we use two supervised stages to establish the semantic knowledge and control capabilities required for reliable native-interface execution.
World knowledge injection equips the policy with Minecraft concepts and their visual grounding, while imitation learning teaches it to map subtask instructions and first-person observations to native keyboard-and-mouse actions.
Further details on data sources, sample construction and curation, training objectives, and optimization settings are provided in Appendix 10 .

blocks.en: 5 Task Completion State Detector
blocks.zh: 5 任务完成状态探测器

blocks.en:
We introduce a novel policy-coupled task completion state detector to support the harness in determining when to pause the VLA invocation.
To reduce system overhead, the detector shares the VLA image encoder and additionally conditions on VLA policy context for completion prediction, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B serving as its backbone.
At each query, the detector uses the shared image encoder and its self-attention stream to process historical frames sampled at 800 800 , 600 600 , 400 400 , and 200 ​ ms 200\,\mathrm{ms} before the query, while the VLA processes the current frame and subtask instruction.
The final-layer hidden states of the input prefix preceding the first action token form the policy context H t π H_{t}^{\pi} , which is injected through cross-attention after every fourth detector decoder layer.
Let Z t ( ℓ ) Z_{t}^{(\ell)} denote the detector hidden states at layer ℓ \ell . We apply query-normalized residual cross-attention as Z ~ t ( ℓ ) = Z t ( ℓ ) + MHA ℓ ⁡ ( LN ℓ ⁡ ( Z t ( ℓ ) ) , H t π , H t π ) , \widetilde{Z}_{t}^{(\ell)}=Z_{t}^{(\ell)}+\operatorname{MHA}_{\ell}\left(\operatorname{LN}_{\ell}(Z_{t}^{(\ell)}),H_{t}^{\pi},H_{t}^{\pi}\right), (5) where each cross-attention module has independent projection parameters.
To further reduce detector overhead, we use Wanda-inspired activation–weight channel scores to prune the intermediate width of each feed-forward network to approximately one third ( Sun et al., 2024 ) .
For classification, we map the detector’s final-token hidden state to two logits through a linear classification head and apply a softmax to obtain the completion probability p t p_{t} .
We train the detector with the VLA frozen on completion labels derived from VPT human gameplay trajectories ( Baker et al., 2022 ) .
At deployment, the detector runs before action decoding and raises a candidate completion signal to the harness only when p t p_{t} exceeds τ \tau for two consecutive queries.
Details of dataset construction, channel pruning and training are provided in Appendix 11 .

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We instantiate HiSTEVE with GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) as the upper-level planner and Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as the low-level VLA.

LongBench evaluates whether atomic native-control capabilities remain effective when they must be repeatedly composed over extended interaction.
Unlike atomic benchmarks, success depends not only on executing individual subtasks, but also on maintaining task state across invocations and adapting subsequent decisions to observed outcomes.
We evaluate Resource & Crafting, Exploration & Memory, Recovery, and Open-ended tasks using final-goal success as the primary metric, with hidden diagnostic nodes used only for progress analysis.

We evaluate completion detection on a class-balanced validation split of 4,674 4{,}674 samples drawn from VPT trajectories ( Baker et al., 2022 ) across four task families: mining, killing, crafting, and smelting (details see Appendix 11.1 ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We present HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent combining a capability-aware agent harness for long-horizon autonomy with native-interface control.
The harness enables long-horizon autonomy through capability-constrained planning, evidence-driven handoff and recovery, and structured memory.
Regime-specific representations and three-stage training enable a single VLA to reliably handle both non-GUI and GUI interactions.
HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on MineStudio Bench ( 85.0 % 85.0\% ) and OpenHA ( 37.4 % 37.4\% ) and can craft an iron pickaxe from scratch using only human-interface.
Our work shows that regime-specific representations support reliable control across heterogeneous tasks, while reliable long-horizon execution further requires a harness that combines local control with state-aware orchestration.
These results represent a step toward virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games human players.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍HiSTEVE,一种具有分级的VLA代理人,结合一种能力意识的代理手段,实现长视距自治和本地界面控制。
这种利用通过能力受限的规划、由证据驱动的交接和恢复以及结构化的内存,实现了长视距自主。
制度特有的表述和三阶段培训使一个VLA能够可靠地处理非GUI和GUI的互动.
HiSTEVE在MineStudio Beach(85.0% 85.0\%)和OpenHA(37.4% 37.4\%)上实现了最先进的性能,并且可以只用人相接器从头到尾地手动出一把铁取轴.
我们的工作显示,针对具体制度的表述支持对各种任务的可靠控制,而可靠的长距离执行进一步需要一种将地方控制同国家意识协调相结合的利用。
这些结果代表着朝向在开放式游戏中操作的虚拟内含的代理人迈出了一步.

blocks.en: 8.2 Capability-Constrained Atomic Interface
blocks.zh: 8.2 能力受限原子接口

blocks.en: Direct free-form decomposition can produce subtasks that are too abstract for reliable execution by the VLA, or conversely, subtasks that are so narrow that they require unnecessarily frequent high-level decisions. HiSTEVE therefore exposes the lower-level VLA to the planner through a parameterized atomic interface.
blocks.zh: 直接自由形式分解可以产生过于抽象而无法由VLA可靠执行的子任务,或者反之,子任务如此狭窄而需要不必要的频繁高层决定. 因此,HiSTEVE通过参数化原子界面将下级的VLA暴露给规划者.

blocks.en: Each atomic schema s ∈ 𝒮 s\in\mathcal{S} is represented as s = ( 𝒜 s , 𝒫 s , 𝒞 s , ℱ s , B s ) , s=\left(\mathcal{A}_{s},\mathcal{P}_{s},\mathcal{C}_{s},\mathcal{F}_{s},B_{s}\right), (11) where 𝒜 s \mathcal{A}_{s} denotes the semantic arguments of the subtask, 𝒫 s \mathcal{P}_{s} its applicability conditions, 𝒞 s \mathcal{C}_{s} its visually observable completion criteria, ℱ s \mathcal{F}_{s} recognizable failure conditions, and B s B_{s} the execution budget.

blocks.en: The schema library defines the capability boundary presented to the planner. It does not contain scripted implementations of the corresponding subtasks. Once a schema is instantiated, all physical interactions required to realize the semantic objective are produced by the VLA through native keyboard-and-mouse actions.
blocks.zh: schema库定义了提交规划者的能力边界. 它不包含相应的子任务的脚本执行. 一旦一个计划被即时化,实现语义目标所需的所有物理相互作用都由VLA通过原生键盘-和-mouse动作产生.

blocks.en: For count-based objectives, the harness does not issue an indefinitely running instruction such as “collect N N items.” Instead, it repeatedly invokes bounded acquisition subtasks. After invocation j j , the remaining requirement is updated according to the visually verified progress: r j + 1 = max ⁡ ( 0 , r j − Δ j ) , r_{j+1}=\max\left(0,r_{j}-\Delta_{j}\right), (12) where Δ j \Delta_{j} denotes newly verified progress during the current invocation.
blocks.zh: 对于基于计数的目标,控制器不会发布“收集NN物品”等无限期运行的指令。 相反,它一再援引受约束的收购子任务。 引用 j 后,其余要求根据可视化核实的进展更新: r j + 1 = 最大 → (0, r j → j ), r j + 1 → max\ left (0, r_{j}-\ Delta_{j}\right (12)),其中 j + Delta_{j 表示当前引用过程中新核实的进展.

blocks.en: This decomposition prevents already acquired resources from being repeatedly counted as new progress and avoids continuing a stale local instruction after the corresponding requirement has already been satisfied.
blocks.zh: 这种分解防止了已经获得的资源被反复算作新的进展,并避免了在相应要求得到满足后继续进行僵化的当地教学。

blocks.en: 8.3 Evidence-Driven Verification and Recovery
blocks.zh: 8.3 取证核实和追回

blocks.en: HiSTEVE explicitly separates execution handoff from task verification. A detector-triggered handoff only indicates a candidate semantic boundary. After control returns, the harness reassesses the current and recent visual observations and evaluates the completion and failure predicates associated with the active subtask.
blocks.zh: HiSTEVE明确区分执行交接和任务核查. 探测器触发的交接只表示候选语义边界. 控制返回后,控制器重新评估当前和最近的视觉观察,并评价与活动子任务相关的完成和故障上游.

blocks.en: The resulting execution outcome is represented as v j ∈ { success , failure , interrupted } , v_{j}\in\left\{\mathrm{success},\mathrm{failure},\mathrm{interrupted}\right\}, (13) where interrupted \mathrm{interrupted} indicates that control has returned to the harness but neither success nor failure can yet be visually verified.

blocks.en: The updated planning state is then h j + 1 = 𝒰 ⁡ ( h j , u j , v j , O j + 1 ) , h_{j+1}=\mathcal{U}\left(h_{j},u_{j},v_{j},O_{j+1}\right), (14) where 𝒰 \mathcal{U} denotes the harness state-update operation and O j + 1 O_{j+1} contains the visual evidence available after the invocation.

blocks.en: During deployment, the planner and VLA interact with the environment only through first-person observations and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. Simulator-side state used during training for reward construction or trajectory certification is not provided to the deployed planner or VLA.
blocks.zh: 在部署期间,规划员和VLA只能通过第一人称观察和本土键盘和mouse动作来与环境互动. 培训期间用于奖励建造或轨迹认证的模拟-侧状态不提供给已部署的规划员或甚高分辨率飞行器。

blocks.en: For example, resource acquisition is accepted only after the corresponding inventory change is visually confirmed. Likewise, crafting or smelting is not considered complete merely because an intermediate GUI state is reached; the resulting item must be visually observed in the player inventory.
blocks.zh: 例如,只有在相应的库存变动被视同确认后,才接受资源购置。 同样,仅仅因为达到中间图形界面状态,工艺或冶炼不被认为是完整的;因此产生的物品必须在玩家的库存中被视觉观察.

blocks.en: Recovery is used for local execution deviations that do not invalidate the high-level objective, such as temporary lack of progress, inconsistent GUI state, target loss, or a produced item that has not yet been collected. If recovery is infeasible or repeatedly fails, the current subtask becomes inapplicable, or the observed state changes substantially, the harness invokes the planner again from the updated task state.
blocks.zh: 回收用于本地执行偏差,不会使高级目标失效,如暂时没有进展,图形用户界面状态不一致,目标丢失,或一个已出品但尚未收集的项目. 如果恢复不可行或屡次失败,当前子任务变得不适用,或者被观测到的状态发生实质性变化,则从更新后的任务状态再次引用了规划者.

blocks.en: 8.4 Structured Memory
blocks.zh: 8.4 有结构的内存

blocks.en: Long-horizon execution requires persistent task state, but retaining the complete raw interaction history rapidly increases context length and preserves many transient or unverified intermediate states. HiSTEVE instead maintains a compact memory centered on verified subtask-level state transitions.
blocks.zh: 长相执行需要持续的任务状态,但保留完整的原始互动历史会迅速增加上下文长度并保留许多瞬间或未经验证的中间状态. HiSTEVE转而维持一个以已核实的子任务级状态过渡为核心的紧凑内存.

blocks.en: The memory system consists of four complementary stores: • Working memory records the current objective, active subtask, verified progress, unresolved requirements, and recent failure or no-progress states. • Episodic memory records the state transition associated with each bounded VLA invocation, together with the selected subtask, harness-verified outcome, execution cost, and diagnostic information. • Procedural memory stores reusable dependencies among parameterized subtasks extracted from verified successful executions. • World memory stores visually inferred landmarks and spatial relations that may support later planning within the current world.

blocks.en: 9.2 Backbone and Regime Routing
blocks.zh: 9.2 后骨和政权跑道

blocks.en: The VLA policy is instantiated from Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , retaining its original vision encoder, multimodal projector, and autoregressive decoder. The current visual observation and atomic-subtask instruction are serialized using the native Qwen2.5-VL multimodal template. Action symbols are assigned to reserved vocabulary entries that do not overlap with natural-language tokens, allowing actions to be generated through the original autoregressive output head.
blocks.zh: VLA政策从Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等,2025年)即时化出,保留了原有的视觉编码器,多式投影仪和自递式解码器. 目前的视觉观测和原子子任务指令使用原生的Quen2.5-VL多模式模板进行序列化. 动作符号被分配到与自然语言符号不相重叠的保留词汇条目中,允许动作通过原自递回输出头来生成.

blocks.en: Each atomic subtask is associated with an interaction regime c t ∈ { NG , GUI } c_{t}\in\{\mathrm{NG},\mathrm{GUI}\} . This regime serves as an explicit routing variable that selects the corresponding RMSNorm branch and mouse-displacement token set. The same regime is serialized as the interaction-type token after the beginning-of-action token. Apart from the regime-specific RMSNorm parameters and mouse-token embeddings, the remaining backbone parameters are shared across the two regimes.

Following the mouse encoding used in prior Minecraft policies ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , we apply μ \mu -law companding to the horizontal and vertical mouse displacements independently and quantize each transformed axis into 21 21 bins.

blocks.en: 10 VLA Training Strategy Details
blocks.zh: 10 志愿军 培训战略细节

blocks.en: 10.1 World Knowledge Injection
blocks.zh: 10.1 世界知识 注射

blocks.en:
To reliably map subtasks to low-level actions, the policy model must acquire knowledge of Minecraft’s entities, blocks and crafting mechanics. We therefore inject world knowledge by supervised fine-tuning.
We adopt the world knowledge and alignment data released with JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and deduplicate it to remove near-duplicate samples.
We freeze the vision encoder, and fully finetune the language decoder, so that it acquires game world knowledge and aligns it with first-person visual observations.
blocks.zh:
为了可靠地将次级任务划入低级行动,政策模式必须了解Minecraft的实体、块块和工艺技术。 因此,我们通过监督的微调注入世界知识。
我们采用与JARVIS-VLA(Li等,2025年)发布的世界知识和校正数据,并去除近重复样本。
我们冻结了视觉编码器,并充分微调了语言解码器,使其获得游戏世界知识并和第一人称视觉观察相配合.

blocks.en: The world knowledge data contain three supervision formats: text-only knowledge question answering, captioning of in-game screenshots, and visual question answering over the screenshots. Table 8 illustrates the model input and supervised target.
blocks.zh: 世界知识数据包含三种监督格式:只有文本的知识问题回答,游戏中截图的字幕,以及视觉问题在截图上的回答. 表8说明了模型投入和受监督的目标。

blocks.en:
Before training, we apply format-specific normalization, deduplication, and quality filtering; for knowledge-QA targets, we capitalize the initial letter and add missing sentence-final punctuation.
For exact deduplication, we lowercase and whitespace-normalize questions and retain the longest target for each normalized question.
For knowledge QA, we use FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) to retrieve candidate neighbors from all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) and merge candidate pairs with cosine similarity of at least 0.95 0.95 via union–find; for VQA, both text similarity from the same sentence encoder and image similarity computed from CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings ( Radford et al., 2021 ) must be at least 0.85 0.85 .
Finally, we remove QA samples with empty questions or targets, or targets containing at most five words excluding punctuation.
blocks.zh:
在培训之前,我们应用特定格式的正常化、分解和质量过滤;对于知识-QA目标,我们利用最初的字母并添加缺失的句子-最后的标注。
为了精确的分解,我们小写和白空将问题正常化,并保留每个正常化问题最长的目标.
对于知识QA,我们使用FAISS(Johnson等,2019年)从全MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入语(Reimers和Gurevich,2019年;Wang等,2020年)中取出候选邻居,并合并候选对子,通过结合-find至少0.95 0.95;对于VQA,从同句编码器中得出的文本相似性和从CLIP ViT-B/32嵌入语(Radford等,2021年)中计算的图像相似性必须至少为0.85 0.85 0.85.
最后,我们删除QA样本中空出的问题或目标,或包含最多5个字的目标,不包括出点.

blocks.en: 10.2 Imitation Learning

blocks.en:
Starting from the world knowledge checkpoint, we train the policy using VPT gameplay data ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , trajectories released with JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and script-generated trajectories that supplement crafting and smelting recipes.
After deduplication, we resample trajectories by task to balance the task distribution.
Each training example consists of the subtask instruction, the single-frame observation, and the corresponding keyboard-and-mouse action.
At this stage, we duplicate each RMSNorm scale vector to initialize the GUI and non-GUI branches, freeze the vision encoder, and finetune all remaining policy parameters.

从世界知识检查点开始,我们利用VPT游戏机数据(Baker等,2022年),与JARVIS-VLA(Li等,2025年)一起发布的轨迹,以及由脚本生成的可补充工艺和熔炼食谱的轨迹来训练政策.

每个训练实例包括子任务指令,单帧观察,以及相应的键盘-和-mouse动作.
在这个阶段,我们复制了每个 RMSNorm 比例向量来初始化图形界面和非GUI分支,冻结视觉编码器,并微调所有剩余的政策参数.

blocks.en:
For each same-start branch group in Equation 3 , the initial condition fixes the task, world seed, initial inventory, and GUI configuration.
Each branch is executed in a separate Minecraft process to prevent cross-branch state contamination. We record visual observations, action tokens, behavior-policy log-probabilities, parsed environment actions, termination reasons, and trainer-side environment evidence.
For local comparisons, we prioritize candidate segments from the same branch group whose structured state signatures match at the beginning of the segment.
blocks.zh:
Equation 3 中每个相同启动的分支组,初始条件会固定任务,世界种子,初始清单和图形界面配置.
每个分支在单独的"Minecraft"程序中被执行,以防止跨分支状态被污染. 我们记录了视觉观察,动作符号,行为政策日志概率,解析环境行动,终止原因,以及训练方环境证据.
为了进行当地比较,我们优先安排同一分支组的候选人部分,其结构化的国家签名与该部分开始时相符。

blocks.en:
Post-training determines atomic-subtask completion from environment state changes rather than model-reported success.
For an item-acquisition task, the completion certificate for target item g g is C t g = 𝟏 [ N t ( g ) − N 0 ( g ) ≥ δ g ] , C_{t}^{g}=\mathbf{1}\left[N_{t}(g)-N_{0}(g)\geq\delta_{g}\right], (25) where N t ​ ( g ) N_{t}(g) is the inventory count at step t t and δ g \delta_{g} is the required increase relative to the initial state.
Thus, breaking a target block without collecting the drop, or producing an item in a GUI without transferring it to the player inventory, is not considered successful.

blocks.en: 12.2 LongBench Benchmark and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 12.2 长本克基准和评价

blocks.en: LongBench evaluates whether atomic native-control capabilities can be composed into persistent behavior over extended interaction. In contrast to atomic benchmarks, each LongBench episode provides only a final goal: the agent must determine the required intermediate objectives online from its visual observations and execution history. Neither a reference task decomposition nor the benchmark’s diagnostic annotations are exposed to the agent.
blocks.zh: Long Bench)评价原子原生控制能力是否可以组成持续的行为,而不是延伸的相互作用. 与原子基准形成对比的是,"龙本奇"每集只提供了最终目标:代理商必须从其视觉观察和执行历史中在线确定所需的中间目标. 参考任务分解和基准的诊断说明都不接触该剂。

blocks.en: LongBench contains 14 14 goal-only tasks organized into four families that emphasize different long-horizon requirements: Resource & Crafting, Exploration & Memory, Recovery, and Open-ended interaction. Table 5 summarizes the task suite.
blocks.zh: Long Bench包含14个只针对目标的任务,这些任务组织成4个家庭,强调不同的长视野要求:资源与工艺,探索与记忆,恢复,以及开放式互动. 表5概述了任务组合。

blocks.en: Table 5: LongBench task suite. Each episode exposes only the final goal to the agent; the decomposition and diagnostic checkpoints are withheld during execution.
blocks.zh: 表5:长本克任务套房. 每集只向特工暴露出最终入球;分解和诊断检查站被执行时被扣.

blocks.en: The four families serve complementary purposes. Resource & Crafting tasks require the agent to compose multiple native-control skills into a dependency chain whose final object is unavailable at initialization. Exploration & Memory tasks require information gathered earlier in the episode to affect later decisions. Recovery tasks introduce situations in which the current execution path can no longer be continued directly and therefore require local recovery or replanning. Open-ended tasks admit multiple valid strategies and provide less structure about the sequence of intermediate objectives.
blocks.zh: 这四个家庭为辅助目的服务。 资源与工艺任务要求代理将多种本土控制技能编成一个依赖链,其最终对象在初始化时没有. 探索和记忆任务需要在该集早期所收集的信息来影响后期的决定. 恢复任务造成目前执行路径不能再直接继续下去的情况,因此需要当地恢复或重新规划。 不限成员名额的任务接纳了多种有效的战略,对中间目标的顺序提供了较少的结构。

blocks.en: Eleven of the fourteen tasks start from an empty inventory in a natural survival world. Formal evaluation uses fixed environment seeds, while terrain, resource distribution, and naturally occurring entities remain part of the Minecraft environment.
blocks.zh: 14个任务中有11个是从自然生存世界的空盘起步的. 正式评价使用固定环境种子,而地形、资源分配和自然形成的实体仍然是Minecraft环境的一部分。

blocks.en: The three Recovery tasks use controlled initial states to reproducibly instantiate low-frequency recovery scenarios involving tool breakage, alternative fuel, and missed resource pickup.
blocks.zh: 三项恢复任务采用受控初始状态,再现低频恢复情景,涉及工具破损、替代燃料和漏取资源。

blocks.en: These states are instantiated only during reset; subsequent evaluation follows the same native visual and keyboard-and-mouse interface used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 这些状态仅在重置时被即时化;之后的评价遵循的是整个论文中使用的同一种本土视觉和键盘-和-mouse接口.

blocks.en: LongBench additionally defines 49 49 hidden diagnostic nodes across the 14 14 tasks. A diagnostic node denotes an interpretable intermediate state, such as obtaining a prerequisite resource, constructing an intermediate tool, reaching a relevant landmark, or entering a required processing stage.
blocks.zh: Long Bench在14个任务中额外定义了49个隐藏的诊断节点. 一个诊断节点表示一个可解释的中间状态,例如获得一个先决条件资源,构建一个中间工具,达到相关的地标,或者进入一个需要的处理阶段.

blocks.en: These nodes are never included in the planner prompt and are not used to select the next subtask. They are recorded only by the evaluation procedure after execution and therefore provide a diagnostic view of trajectory progress without supplying privileged guidance to the agent.
blocks.zh: 这些节点从未包含在规划器的快取中,也不用于选择下一个子任务. 它们只通过执行后的评价程序加以记录,因此提供了轨迹进展的诊断性观点,而没有向代理人提供特殊指导。

Final-goal success is authoritative: reaching intermediate milestones or producing partial progress does not convert an unsuccessful trajectory into a successful one.
In addition to Goal SR and diagnostic progress, we record environment steps, upper-level planner calls, detector-triggered handoffs, local recovery attempts, and replanning events. These quantities are used for trajectory analysis rather than as optimization objectives.

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of agent orchestration from lower-level policy quality, the harness ablation keeps the native-control VLA and upper-level semantic model fixed. The compared systems therefore share the same local controller and differ only in how repeated VLA invocations are organized over time.
blocks.zh: 为了将代理管弦乐的效果从较低层次的政策质量中分离出来,被管弦乐保持了本土控制VLA和上层语义模型的固定. 因此,比较的系统共用同一个本地控制器,只在如何在一段时间内组织重复的VLA引用方面有所不同.

blocks.en:
The fixed-horizon variant returns control after a predetermined execution boundary. Full HiSTEVE instead uses state-dependent handoff followed by visual verification and planning-state update; incomplete executions may trigger local recovery or replanning.
Because the lower-level VLA is unchanged, this comparison isolates the effect of runtime orchestration from changes in policy weights.
The corresponding controlled results are reported in Table 3 .
blocks.zh:
固定范围变体在预先确定的执行边界后返回控制。 满 HiSTEVE转而使用依赖国家的交接,然后进行视觉核查和规划状态更新;不完全的处决可能会触发当地恢复或重新规划.
由于下层VLA没有变化,这一比较将运行时管弦乐的效果与政策权重的变化相隔离.

blocks.en: LongBench exposes failures that are less visible in atomic benchmarks because successful completion depends on preserving usable state over many policy invocations. We observe three recurring patterns.
blocks.zh: Long Bench 揭露了原子基准中不太明显的失败,因为成功完成取决于在许多政策引用中保持可用状态。 我们观察到三种反复出现的模式。

blocks.en: First, multi-step GUI interactions can leave the environment in a partially correct state that is difficult to continue from reliably. For example, an invocation may correctly place part of a recipe but fail to retrieve the output or recover from an incorrect slot configuration. A subsequent invocation then starts from a state that differs from the demonstrations seen by the policy.
blocks.zh: 首先,多步骤的GUI相互作用可以使环境处于部分正确状态,难以可靠地继续. 例如,引用可能正确放置了食谱的一部分,但未能取回输出或从错误的槽配置中恢复. 然后,从与政策所见示威不同的状态开始援引。

blocks.en: Second, exploration tasks amplify errors in spatial memory. The agent may successfully discover a relevant area but later fail to recover sufficiently precise visual or spatial context for a return objective. These cases distinguish reaching a useful location once from maintaining information that remains actionable several planning steps later.
blocks.zh: 第二,探索任务放大了空间内存中的错误. 该剂可能成功发现一个相关区域,但后来未能为返回目标恢复足够精确的视觉或空间上下文。 这些案件将一次到达一个有用的地点,与以后仍可采取行动的几个规划步骤相区别。

blocks.en: Third, recovery itself consumes execution budget. A local failure may be recoverable, yet repeated attempts can leave insufficient budget for the remaining dependency chain. LongBench therefore measures not only whether recovery is possible, but whether recovery is efficient enough to preserve the feasibility of the overall objective.
blocks.zh: 第三,恢复本身消耗执行预算。 局部失败是可以弥补的,但反复尝试可能会给剩余的依赖链留下预算不足. 因此,Long Bench不仅衡量回收是否可行,而且衡量回收是否足够有效,以维护总体目标的可行性。

blocks.en: These observations explain why diagnostic progress can substantially exceed final-goal success: HiSTEVE often completes meaningful portions of a long trajectory before a later execution or recovery failure prevents satisfaction of the terminal predicate.
blocks.zh: 这些意见解释了为什么诊断性进展可能大大超过最终目标的成功: HiSTEVE常常在后来执行或恢复失败之前完成长轨的有意义的部分,使终端上游无法满足。

blocks.en: 12.3 Controlled Harness Evaluation
blocks.zh: 12.3 控制下的合理性评价

blocks.en: The harness ablation is designed to separate improvements in agent orchestration from changes in lower-level policy quality. Across compared variants, we hold the native-control VLA, upper-level semantic model, task definitions, and evaluation protocol fixed.
blocks.zh: 节能节能是为了将代理管弦的改进同较低层次政策质量的变化区分开来. 在比较的变体中,我们固定了本地控制VLA、高级语义模型、任务定义和评价协议。

blocks.en: The fixed-horizon variant executes the same atomic instruction until a predetermined execution boundary before returning control to the upper level. Full HiSTEVE instead uses state-dependent completion signals followed by visual verification, structured task-state update, local recovery, and replanning.
blocks.zh: 固定视距变体执行相同的原子指令,直到预先确定的执行边界,然后将控制还原到上层。 满 HiSTEVE转而使用依赖状态的完成信号,然后进行视觉验证,结构化的任务状态更新,局部恢复,以及重新规划.

blocks.en: Because the underlying VLA is fixed, differences in long-horizon performance primarily reflect how the same local controller is organized across repeated invocations. This is also why we report atomic metrics for the same comparison: large changes in long-horizon behavior accompanied by only small changes in atomic performance provide evidence that the gain arises from orchestration rather than from a stronger controller.
blocks.zh: 由于基础的VLA是固定的,长视性能的差异主要反映了同一本地控制器如何通过反复引用来组织. 这也是为什么我们报告原子度量衡进行同样的比较的原因:长视线行为的巨大变化,加上原子性能的微小变化,提供了证据,证明收益来自管弦乐而不是更强大的控制器.

blocks.en:
We study three design choices in the state detector: FFN pruning, cross-attention density, and policy-context injection.
Our final configuration uses Wanda-inspired scores ( Sun et al., 2024 ) to retain approximately one-third of each FFN, inserts cross-attention after every fourth detector layer, and supplies the same final-layer policy context H t π H_{t}^{\pi} to all cross-attention modules.
All variants use the Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone and are evaluated on the same class-balanced validation set of 4,674 4{,}674 samples.
Table 6 summarizes these controlled comparisons; each ablation variant changes only one factor, with all remaining settings fixed to the final configuration.

Reducing the FFN width from one-half to one-third changes accuracy only from 0.865 0.865 to 0.863 0.863 , whereas reducing it further to one-quarter decreases accuracy to 0.739 0.739 .
We therefore use one-third as the most compact tested width that preserves detection performance.

将FFN宽度从一半降低到三分之一,只有0.865 0.865到0.863 0.863的精度,而将精度进一步降低到四分之一后再降低到0.739 0.739.
因此,我们使用三分之一作为最紧凑的试验宽度,以保持探测性能。

blocks.en:
At the same one-third width, naive prefix truncation reduces accuracy from 0.863 0.863 to 0.768 0.768 .
This result demonstrates the importance of selecting retained channels according to their activation–weight importance.
We therefore use Wanda-inspired activation–weight scores for channel selection in the final detector.
blocks.zh:
同为三分之一宽度,天真前缀截取将精度从0.863 0.863降至0.768 0.768.
这一结果表明,必须根据其活性-重量重要性选择保留渠道。
因此,我们使用万达启发的活化-加权分数来选择最终探测器中的频道。

blocks.en:
Inserting cross-attention every two layers achieves an accuracy of 0.869 0.869 , whereas inserting it after every layer yields 0.859 0.859 , showing that greater density does not provide gains.
The every-fourth-layer configuration uses only 9 9 modules, compared with 18 18 and 36 36 in the denser variants, while remaining within 0.006 0.006 accuracy of the best result.
We therefore adopt the every-fourth-layer placement to balance detection performance and overhead.
blocks.zh:
每两层插入交叉意向,精度达到0.869 0.869;每层后插入则达到0.859 0.859,显示密度较大不会产生增益.
每四层配置只使用9个9个模块,而密度更强的变体则使用18个18个和36个36个模块,而最佳结果的准确度则保持在0.006.006以内.
因此,我们采用每四层的位置,以平衡探测性能和间接费用。

blocks.en:
Using depth-matched intermediate policy representations reduces accuracy from 0.863 0.863 to 0.690 0.690 .
This substantial gap supports broadcasting the final-layer policy context to all cross-attention modules, as it integrates information from the current observation and subtask.
We therefore broadcast the same final-layer policy context H t π H_{t}^{\pi} to all cross-attention modules in the final detector.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 15 Discussion
blocks.zh: 15 讨论情况

blocks.en: HiSTEVE suggests that a central challenge in long-horizon agency is maintaining task state across planning and control decisions. The agent harness provides this continuity by preserving task state, aligning plans with executable capabilities, and using execution outcomes to make decisions.
blocks.zh: HiSTEVE建议,长视机构的一个中心挑战是在规划和控制决定中保持任务状态。 代理人利用通过保持任务状态,使计划与可执行能力相配合,并利用执行结果作出决定,提供这种连续性。

blocks.en:
With the lower-level VLA fixed, the complete harness changes aggregate atomic performance only modestly while substantially improving LongBench goal success. This suggests that long-horizon capability depends not only on the strength of the local controller, but also on how existing capabilities are organized across repeated invocations, with task state preserved and subsequent decisions adapted to execution outcomes.
A further design insight is to decouple control handoff from task-success verification. The completion detector provides only a candidate handoff signal, while the harness subsequently verifies completion from visual evidence, preventing individual detector errors from being directly committed to persistent task state.
blocks.zh:
在下级VLA被固定后,完整的牵引力仅能适度地改变总原子性能,而能大幅度地改善长本奇目标的成功. 这表明,长距离能力不仅取决于当地控制者的实力,而且取决于如何通过反复引用来组织现有能力,任务状态得到保留,随后的决定也适应执行结果。
另一个设计洞察力是将控制交接与任务成功核查脱钩. 完成检测器只提供候选的交接信号,而后被接接接器通过视觉证据验证完成,防止单个检测器出错被直接用于持续的任务状态.

blocks.en: The current system has two main limitations. First, its atomic subtask interfaces are manually defined, and its capabilities remain limited by the existing VLA policy; adding new atomic capabilities requires additional training data and policy updates, while neither the harness nor the VLA currently performs parametric continual learning from deployment experience. In addition, high-level planning relies on an off-the-shelf VLM, making overall system performance dependent on the capabilities of the selected VLM backend.
blocks.zh: 目前的制度有两个主要的局限性。 首先,其原子子任务接口是人工定义的,其能力仍然受现有VLA政策所限制;增加新的原子能力需要额外的培训数据和政策更新,而目前无论是利用还是VLA都没有从部署经验中持续学习参数学. 此外,高层次的规划依赖于现成的VLM,使得整体系统性能依赖于所选VLM后端的能力.

blocks.en: Future work could enable independent or joint evolution of the VLA and harness: the VLA could learn continually from failure and recovery trajectories, while the harness updates its planning constraints and recovery strategies from experience. A complementary direction is to use Minecraft as training an environment for agent intelligence, examining whether planning, memory, and recovery capabilities can transfer across games and ultimately to interactive domains beyond games.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以促进志愿军的独立或联合演进和利用:志愿军可以不断从失败和复原轨迹中吸取教训,同时利用经验更新其规划限制和恢复战略。 一个互补的方向是利用Minecraft作为代理智能的训练环境,检查规划,内存和恢复能力是否可以跨游戏,并最终转移到游戏以外的交互式领域.
